question: What total does just.hosting's checkout charge for Sirius (fees, VAT), and does the order API accept a guest?
why: the order form on the Sirius page posts to the site's own API (/api/v1/cloud-vps/configurator, then /api/v1/cloud-vps/order) behind a login/register step, and no guest cart page exists, so the final charged total is readable only with an account; the tariff card's USD 8.09/month and USD 6.47/month on 12 months are the published prices
